description: Bleeding freely — 5 Endurance at the end of every round until it is stopped.
name: Bleeding

description: A big wound bleeding hard, though no major artery — 10 Endurance at the end of every round until it is stopped.
name: Heavy Bleeding

description: Bleeding from a shallow wound — 2 Endurance at the end of every round until it is stopped.
name: Light Bleeding

description: Target cannot see; auto-misses sight-based attacks.
name: Blinded

description: Target perceives the caster as a friend; cannot harm them.
name: Charmed

description: Mental haze; -2 to mental attribute checks.
name: Concussed

description: Persistent magical affliction; specific effect varies by curse.
name: Cursed

description: Target cannot hear; auto-fails hearing-based checks.
name: Deafened

description: Target drops what they're wielding.
name: Disarmed

description: Persistent affliction; specific effect varies by disease.
name: Diseased

description: Hardened by umbra to Speed 0: encased, suffocating over minutes.
name: Encased

description: Persistent injury reducing movement / accuracy until healed.
name: Fractured

description: Target must flee; disadvantage on attacks vs source.
name: Frightened

description: Target's movement reduced to 1; tier 1 of the grapple escalation.
name: Grappled

description: Endurance drained to 0 by a siphon: it stays at 0, speed is halved, and any damage wounds. A normal wound refills Endurance and ends it.
name: Guttering

description: A major artery is open. LETHAL — 25 Endurance at the end of every round, and it does not stop on its own.
name: Hemorrhage

description: Target cannot be seen; attacks against gain disadvantage.
name: Invisible

description: Target hurled away from the source.
name: Knocked Back

description: Target raised into the air; falling damage on release.
name: Lifted

description: Target cannot move or act; auto-fails physical saves.
name: Paralyzed

description: Target cannot move; tier 2.
name: Pinned

description: Target is on the ground; melee attackers gain advantage.
name: Knocked Prone

description: Target pulled toward the source.
name: Pulled

description: Target cannot move OR take physical actions; tier 3.
name: Restrained

description: Acting through a root clone: the body roots in place (Speed 0) until the last clone is gone.
name: Rooted

description: Target pushed away from the source.
name: Shoved

description: Target's speed halved.
name: Slowed

description: Target loses next reaction; flat-footed for 1 round.
name: Staggered

description: Target loses next turn entirely.
name: Stunned
